info.title: /dev/null
info.description: The JSON API the /dev/null apps use. Reading public profiles and commits needs nothing; acting for someone needs a request signed with an SSH key they approved as a device.

A commit from the mobile app, sent as JSON, or with images as multipart (see SignedRequests). It may reply to a commit

anyone its parent was addressed to, as the web's Replying to picks them.
